capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Polestar US page: 100 kWh capacity, cell-to-pack, 110 cells (gross not labelled; EV Database lists 94 usable of 100). Polestar US/CA pages show one set of figures for Rear motor and Dual motor.

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: EV Database: 94.0 kWh usable (read from search excerpts; page 429). Polestar pages do not state usable. Wikipedia (opened) also gives NMC and 400 V.

chemistry.notes: Estimated: EV Database excerpt: NCM811 cathode, CATL Qilin cell-to-pack. Not named on Polestar pages. Wikipedia (opened) also gives NMC and 400 V.

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: US owner manual says "Battery preconditioning automatically starts when a DC fast charging station is set in the built-in navigation app"; no manual control is mentioned, but the manual silence does not prove there is none.

dc_max_kw.notes: Polestar US page: DC up to 200 kW. Canada page identical. Polestar US/CA pages show one set of figures for Rear motor and Dual motor.

ac_max_kw.notes: Polestar US page: AC 11 kW; Canada page the same. (UK listings give 22 kW; not this market.)
